Exciting AI Updates Weekly - May 8, 2026
Presented by Lev Selector

Slides on GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dmj00iilSP-JYmriMUUaHCKz5X54e3UX?ths=true

Slides on GitHub - https://github.com/lselector/seminar
    (click on pptx file, then on "raw" or download button on the right)

-------------------------------------------------------
Question to you:
Do you use a personal Digital "Employee"?
If not, then why not? It is so easy to start!

-------------------------------------------------------
Need AI Consulting ?

 - GitHub - https://github.com/lselector

-------------------------------------------------------
Our books:

https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWLNVQMJ/

https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GBXLCTZQ

"FP&A + AI: How to Work Faster, Smarter, and Deliver More Value"
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FY6Z5BBW

--------- Contents of today's video:

00:00 In 2026, your agents have agents
00:15 Crowd-sourced "LM Arena" Leaderboard
00:53 Deepseek-TUI Harness
01:51 Anthropic Wall Street $1.5 Bln Partnership
02:13 Anthropic SpaceX Compute Deal
02:47 Anthropic Claude Security
03:04 New in Claude Managed Agents
04:20 xAI Grok Connectors
05:07 OpenSwarm AI - open-source multi-agent system
05:41 Agentic AI Communication Chain
06:42 Perplexity Workflows
06:59 Miscellaneous AI news
08:12 OpenClaw Updates
08:48 Hermes Agent Curator
09:07 No AI Agent Orchestration Needed
10:42 Harness more important than the model
11:12 InsForge - Backend for AI Coding Agents
11:45 Google Deepmind AI co-clinician
12:08 TradingAgents
12:32 Superpowers Agentic Framework
13:18 Andre Karpathy - talk at Sequoia Event
15:14 Boris Cherny: Why Coding Is Solved
16:13 How Claude Code Works
17:05 Higgsfield AI - Cinematic AI Videos
17:29 Suno AI Music Generation
18:15 Microsoft Copilot Actions and Cowork
18:42 Codex CLI's new "/goal" feature
19:08 Hermes Agent "goals" system
19:23 Google Remy competes with OpenClaw
19:44 OpenAI GPT 4.5 Instant
20:00 HyperFrames open-source HTML-to-video
20:48 Unity AI in open beta for Unity 6 developers
21:05 Zed Editor vs VS Code
24:14 Jujutsu Version Control
24:55 Weave and Mergiraf - Better Merge
25:23 Jack Dorsey Lays off 4K workers
25:58 Mo Gawdat on How to Position Yourself
26:37 Jobs & Layoffs

----

Takeaways:

1. Harness engineering now matters more than the model itself. Same model with a different harness can yield up to six times the performance, and audit the harness before switching models.

2. Frontier models have become smart enough to handle complex tasks holistically. Heavy multi-agent orchestration often fragments reasoning and produces worse results than a single capable model.

3. Coding is becoming democratized. Boris Cherny calls it a printing press moment where AI agents enable anyone to build software regardless of technical background.

----

Quotes:

"This year, your agents have agents."

"While we can outsource thinking to AI, we cannot outsource understanding or taste."

"Vibe coding raises the floor and agentic engineering raises the ceiling."

----

Summary:
In this weekly AI update from May 8, 2026, Lev Selector reviews dozens of developments.

Anthropic leads the arena and signed major Wall Street and SpaceX compute deals. 

Multiple agentic frameworks emerged, including Hermes, Superpowers, OpenSwarm, and Codex goal feature. 

A key paper shows harness engineering matters more than the model, with six times performance differences possible. 

Frontier models are now capable enough to handle complex tasks without multi-agent orchestration. 

Boris Cherny declares coding solved, calling it a printing press moment. 

Karpathy spoke at Sequoia about agentic engineering versus vibe coding. 

Tools highlighted include Zed editor, Jujutsu version control, Weave merging, Higgsfield video, Suno music, and HyperFrames. 

Layoffs continue with PayPal cutting almost 5000 and Jack Dorsey laying off 4000 as companies pivot to AI.

----
